tmp:2105: studying or praying with dchilu u-rchimu (awe and love) — the devotional mode that joins the breath-heh and voice-vav to reveal divine Kingship
tmp:2106: the gevanim (divine colors/hues) becoming revealed and shining — illumination of the color-lights within one's money rectified through tzedakah
tmp:2107: knowing that God is hidden there — the da'at-awareness that Hashem is clothed even within concealment-within-concealment
tmp:2108: doing teshuvah and removing one's foolishness (tipshut/ruach shtut) — the repentance-act that restores intellect and brings manifest shame to the face
tmp:2109: praying with all one's strength and putting one's koach into the letters of the prayer — the devotional practice of investing bodily power in tefillah's letters
tmp:2110: one's strength being renewed there (in the prayer-letters) — the renewal of koach per 'they are new every morning' (Lam. 3:23)
tmp:2111: placing the bed between north and south — the Talmudic bedroom practice symbolizing zivug/prayer, equated with hand-clapping in prayer
tmp:2113: diminution of the blood in the left ventricle of the heart — weakening of the yetzer's seat achieved by turning dam (blood) into dom (silence)
tmp:2114: chesed (kindness) being drawn into the world — the flow of divine lovingkindness released when the idolatry of money and its charon-af are nullified
tmp:2115: enlightening others (le-haskil) — the act by the man of intellect of imparting sekhel in divine service to one poor in da'at
tmp:2116: the arousal occurring also in oneself — the reflexive awakening in the enlightener when he stirs intellect/compassion in another
tmp:2117: the heart being aroused — awakening of the lev by the thunder-voice, per 'sound arouses concentration' (kol me'orer ha-kavanah)
tmp:2118: arousal of the compassion that is Da'at, together with prayer — awakening the greater Merciful One's rachmanut via tefillah for complete salvation
tmp:2119: telling stories of tzaddikim — the practice whose told reshimu (impression) of the tzaddik's service inflames the heart toward God
tmp:2120: 'waters upon the mountains' (Chagigah 12b cosmology) — the heart-waters ('pour out your heart like water') upon which the prayer-pillars stand
tmp:2122: elevating Malkhut of holiness from exile among the idolatrous nations — reclaiming the Elohim-kingship the nations suckle from
tmp:2123: the 'legs' of Torah and prayer — Torah and tefillah as amidah/standing-feet (raglin), prefiguring Messiah's feet on the Mount of Olives
tmp:2124: being drawn near — the messianic reconnection signified by 'His feet shall stand on the Mount of Olives' (Zech. 14:4) via the Torah-prayer legs
tmp:2125: being healed from the falling sickness (epilepsy) — recovery from choli nofel caused by bloods surging and compressing the mochin
tmp:2126: dam brit — the covenant-blood (of circumcision) that rectifies niddah-blood/lust for money, per 'also by the blood of your covenant' (Zech. 9:11)
tmp:2127: Torah as that which arouses the middah of Avraham (chesed) — nighttime Torah study drawing the thread of kindness that rectifies speech
tmp:2128: everything being rectified (nitakken ha-kol) — the total tikkun effected by the three modes of closeness to tzaddikim
tmp:2129: strife being rectified/nullified — resolution of machloket (Korach vs. Aharon, left vs. right) through hand-clapping uniting the sides
tmp:2130: all one's money being rectified — the tikkun of one's entire mamon effected by giving tzedakah, becoming 'Mine is the silver and gold'
tmp:2131: rectification of the World of Speech (olam ha-dibbur) — repairing Malkhut/speech through the joy of abundant mitzvot enabling confession
tmp:2132: segol — the three-dot vowel-point symbolizing the three conditions of teshuvah: eye seeing, ear hearing, heart understanding (Isa. 6:10)
tmp:2133: segol of KS"A (161, Ehyeh spelled with yuds) — the vowel/name-expansion of 'essak shamayim,' the expertise-in-ascent (baki be-ratzo)
tmp:2134: gazing at the tzitzit — the act of looking upon the fringes (its threads, windings, knots) as a healing remedy for the sick
tmp:2135: segulah for a sick person — the remedy for a choleh, namely gazing at the tzitzit, encoded in 'behold your son Yosef comes to you'
tmp:2136: distributing tzedakah lavishly (pizzur) — scattering charity per 'pizar natan la-evyonim' (Ps. 112:9), whose initials spell nofel
tmp:2137: segulah for the falling sickness (epilepsy) — the remedy for choli nofel, namely distributing charity (acronym nofel in Ps. 112:9)
tmp:2139: Kena'ani — 'Canaanite' as merchant/trader (per Rashi on Hos. 12:8 'Canaan, in his hand deceitful scales'), emblem of commerce
tmp:2140: socher — the merchant/trader figure (as in Rashi's 'Ishmaelite merchant'), emblem of commerce arising from lack of peace
tmp:2143: Esav as the complete dross and refuse (sigim u-pesolet) — the waste-product born from Yitzchak's din, opposite of Yaakov's sweetened wisdom
tmp:2145: the waters of the chasadim — kindness-waters that are the sukkah sheltering from 'the strife of tongues' (Ps. 31:21)
tmp:2146: sikhlut — foolishness as the body/animal/matter/darkness pole, opposite of chokhmah-wisdom (Eccl. 2:13)
tmp:2148: safun — 'esteemed/treasured,' the wordplay (safun ve-chashuv) underlying the 'ship' (sefinta) as Israel's grace and importance that the yetzer-wave seeks to sink
tmp:2149: the supernal heart (lev shel-ma'alah) — the heart on high, identified with the Book of Remembrance, from which the yearning learner receives
tmp:2150: Sefer Zikaron — the heavenly Book of Remembrance (Mal. 3:16) in which words of the God-fearing are written, identified with the supernal heart
tmp:2151: the aforementioned gevanim (color-lights) as the greatness of the Creator — the divine hues whose perception the imaginative faculty blocks at the gate of intellect
